definitions: A small Old World passerine bird, Erithacus rubecula, of the thrush family, having a brown back and an orange-red breast and face.
A small North American passerine bird, Turdus migratorius, of the thrush family, having a grey back and an orange-red breast.
examples: A robin built a nest in the garden.
Robins are a common sight in British gardens.
